concept.subject: The rooftops of an old town around a clock tower: gables, a mansard roof, a round turret and rows of chimneys under bands of cloud.
concept.composition: A clock tower stands just right of the middle, its lantern at about a third of the height and its clock at a little over half. The roofs fill the lower half: a large building with a round turret and skylights on the left, an orange building left of the tower, an orange house with a long stepped gable and a dark mansard roof with dormers right of it, a cream gable at the right edge and low roofs with dormers along the bottom. Bands of cloud cross the sky above.
concept.layout: 109 round pegs and 32 bricks. The roofs' edges are bricks: the slopes of the small orange gable, the stepped gable and the cream gable, the hip of the dark roof in front of the tower, the eaves, the turret's ring, the parapet and the cornice over the clock, so balls slide off into the gaps between the houses. Pegs mark the dome, the skylights, the windows, the dormers, the chimney pots, the ridge and eaves of the dark roof and the low roofs along the bottom; six rows of pegs follow the lower edges of the cloud bands. The tower's lantern and four chimneys are solids with peaked tops, and the clock is a peg sheltered under the cornice. Pegs on the houses by the walls stop above the flippers' swing.

difficulty.note: The stage opener and its easiest level: open cloud rows above, short roof slides and gaps between the houses below; only the clock sits under a shelter.

background.prompt: A photo of an old town's rooftops around a clock tower under an overcast sky crossed by bands of cloud. The tower stands just right of the middle, about a ninth of the picture wide: a thin spire at about a quarter of the height over a small lantern, a belfry with arched openings down to about half the height, and a yellow clock stage with a round clock at a little over half the height. The roofs fill the lower half from about 0.52 of the height: on the left a large cream building with a round turret and dome, a skylit roof and rows of windows; left of the tower an orange building with a dark roof; right of the tower an orange house with a long stepped gable and a dark mansard roof with three dormers; at the right edge a cream gable under a chimney; dark low roofs with dormers along the bottom. Chimneys stand all along the skyline. The top center is open sky; the lower corners show house walls.

picture.title: Scenic view of Stockholm's historic rooftops and a distinctive bell tower under a cloudy sky.
picture.author: Silambarasan
